title: Server Detail
description: One server, or all of them. Gauges turn amber at 80% and red at 90%. Visual theme: Sunset Orange.

options.content: CPU, memory, and disk gauges are orange from 80% and red from 90%. Swap is orange from 50% because using disk as memory slows the server. Load per CPU above 1.5 means work is waiting. A single zombie process is shown but does not mark the server unhealthy.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of CPU time that is not idle, averaged over 5 minutes.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: RAM that applications cannot use. Linux cache counts as available.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Fullest data filesystem. The EFI partition is excluded.

panels.title: Swap
panels.description: Share of swap in use. 0% on a server with no swap file is normal.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Combined status from CPU, memory, disk, swap, load, failed services, and whether metrics are arriving.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the last boot.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: 1-minute load average. Compare it with CPUs. A load above the CPU count means work is queued.

panels.title: CPUs
panels.description: Number of CPU cores Node Exporter can see.

panels.title: Load per CPU
panels.description: Load divided by CPU count. Above 1.5 the server is overloaded.

targets.expr: max by (server, environment) (node_load1{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"} / on(server, instance) group_left(environment) count by (server, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",mode="idle"}))

panels.title: Reboots in 7 days
panels.description: How many times the boot time changed in 7 days. This is context, not a failure by itself.

panels.title: Server identity
panels.description: Hostname and operating system come from the server itself. IP address is the address Prometheus uses to scrape it. Last boot is the most recent restart. Reboots in 7 days counts boot-time changes and does not by itself mean the server is unhealthy.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: RAM as the operating system reports it. Available includes memory Linux can reclaim from cache, so Used is memory applications cannot have. Values are shown in GiB.

panels.title: Disk space
panels.description: Important filesystems only. The small EFI partition is hidden because it does not hold application data. Change in 6 hours is the real change in used space, not a forecast. Positive means the disk filled. Negative means space was freed. Days until full extends that 6-hour change and is shown only while used space is growing. Otherwise it says Stable.

options.content: The first table is the live measurement. The second table is the matching alert and how long it has been firing. Open **Alerts and Logs** for the service log.

panels.title: Current problems
panels.description: A row appears only when a live check is outside its limit. Reading is the current measurement: a percent for CPU, memory, disk, and swap; a ratio for load; a count for services and processes; errors per second for the network; days for a disk that is filling. An empty table means none of these checks are failing.

max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace((node_systemd_unit_state{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",name=~"apache2.service|nginx.service|mysql.service|mariadb.service|postgresql@16-main.service|php8.2-fpm.service|php8.3-fpm.service|php8.4-fpm.service|docker.service|redis.service|redis-server.service|ssh.service",state="inactive"} == 1), "issue", "Service stopped: $1", "name", "(.+)"), "next_step", "This service is installed but not running. Start it if it should be up.", "server", ".+"))
or
max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace(((max by (server, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|aufs",mountpoint!~"/boot/efi",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"} / (-delta(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|aufs",mountpoint!~"/boot/efi",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[6h]) * 4)) and (-delta(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|aufs",mountpoint!~"/boot/efi",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[6h]) > 0))) < 14), "issue", "Disk $1 may fill within 14 days", "mountpoint", ".+"), "next_step", "At the growth rate of the last 6 hours, this filesystem runs out of space soon. Find the files that are growing.", "server", ".+"))
or
max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (server) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|virbr.*",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[5m]) + rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|virbr.*",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[5m])) > 1), "issue", "Network errors are above 1 per second", "server", ".+"), "next_step", "The network interface is reporting errors. Check the link and recent network changes.", "server", ".+"))
or
max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace((sum by (server) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|virbr.*",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[5m]) + rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|cali.*|flannel.*|cni.*|virbr.*",job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[5m])) > 1), "issue", "Dropped packets are above 1 per second", "server", ".+"), "next_step", "Packets are being dropped. The server or the network path cannot keep up.", "server", ".+"))
or
max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace(((sum by (server) (node_processes_state{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",state="Z"})) >= 10), "issue", "Many zombie processes", "server", ".+"), "next_step", "Ten or more finished programs were not collected by their parent. Find the application that is leaving them behind.", "server", ".+"))
or
max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace(((sum by (server) (node_processes_state{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",state="D"})) >= 5), "issue", "Processes are stuck on disk", "server", ".+"), "next_step", "Several programs are waiting on disk. Check disk busy time and the application log.", "server", ".+"))
or
max by (server, issue, next_step) (label_replace(label_replace(((max by (server) (changes(node_boot_time_seconds{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"}[30m]))) > 0), "issue", "Server rebooted in the last 30 minutes", "server", ".+"), "next_step", "Confirm the reboot was planned and that web, database, and Docker services came back.", "server", ".+"))), "__name__", "reading", "server", ".+")

panels.title: How long it has been alerting
panels.description: Prometheus alerts for the selected server. How long is the time since the alert started firing. An empty table means this server has no firing alert. Website alerts stay on the website dashboard.

DiskFillingSoon.text: A disk may fill within 14 days

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU percent over time. The dashed lines are 80% and 90%.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory percent over time.

panels.title: Root disk
panels.description: Main filesystem (/) only. Other filesystems are in the disk table.

panels.title: Swap
panels.description: Swap percent over time. A long orange stretch means memory pressure is not a short spike.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: 1-minute load average.

panels.title: Load per CPU
panels.description: Load divided by CPU count.

targets.expr: max by (server) (node_load1{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$"} / on(server, instance) group_left count by (server, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",mode="idle"}))

panels.title: Download
panels.description: Traffic arriving at the server, excluding loopback and Docker bridges.

panels.title: Upload
panels.description: Traffic leaving the server, excluding loopback and Docker bridges.

panels.title: Disk read
panels.description: Bytes read per second from real disks. CD-ROM devices are excluded.

panels.title: Disk write
panels.description: Bytes written per second from real disks.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: How much of the time the disk was busy. Near 100% the disk is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Network errors
panels.description: Receive and transmit errors per second on real interfaces.

panels.title: Dropped packets
panels.description: Receive and transmit drops per second. Occasional drops can be normal; a sustained rise is not.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the last boot. A drop to the bottom is a reboot.

panels.title: Service status
panels.description: Installed services only. A missing product is not listed and is not treated as healthy or failed. Docker shows whether the Docker service is running. Per-container CPU, memory, and restarts are not collected.

targets.expr:
label_replace(label_replace((max by (server, name) (
  (node_systemd_unit_state{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",name=~"apache2.service|nginx.service|mysql.service|mariadb.service|postgresql@16-main.service|php8.2-fpm.service|php8.3-fpm.service|php8.4-fpm.service|docker.service|redis.service|redis-server.service|ssh.service", state="active"} == 1) * 2
  or
  (node_systemd_unit_state{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",name=~"apache2.service|nginx.service|mysql.service|mariadb.service|postgresql@16-main.service|php8.2-fpm.service|php8.3-fpm.service|php8.4-fpm.service|docker.service|redis.service|redis-server.service|ssh.service", state="failed"} == 1) * 1
  or
  (node_systemd_unit_state{job=~"server-0[123]",server=~"^(?:${server})$",name=~"apache2.service|nginx.service|mysql.service|mariadb.service|postgresql@16-main.service|php8.2-fpm.service|php8.3-fpm.service|php8.4-fpm.service|docker.service|redis.service|redis-server.service|ssh.service", state="inactive"} == 1) * 0
)), "__name__", "unit_state", "name", ".+"), "service", "$1", "name", "(.*)\\.service")

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Programs actively using a CPU at the last sample.

panels.title: Waiting on disk
panels.description: Programs stuck in uninterruptible disk wait. A few can be normal during writes. Five or more is a problem.

panels.title: Zombies
panels.description: Finished programs whose parent has not collected them. One is usually harmless. Ten or more means an application is leaking child processes.

options.content: Docker container status, CPU, memory, and restarts are **not available**. This stack does not run cAdvisor. The service table above shows only whether the Docker service itself is running. Adding container panels would require installing cAdvisor on each server and a new Prometheus scrape job.
